主要内容: On February 21, 2018, SAP SE issued a press release announcing that the Executive Board and the Supervisory Board recommend that shareholders approve a dividend of €1.40 per share for the fiscal year 2017 at the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The document contains forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update or revise these statements. The factors that could affect SAP's future financial results are discussed in SAP's filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 20-F.
